services.name: tandem skydiving
services.desc: A tandem skydive is the best way for you to experience skydiving for the first time. You’ll be harnessed to one of our tandem skydive instructors and they’ll take care of everything - all you have to do is have fun and enjoy the epic view! Jump from 10,500 feet attached to an instructor! You’ll freefall for 40 seconds at 200 km/h, then enjoy a calm parachute ride with breathtaking views. Jump from 14,000 feet attached to an instructor! You’ll freefall for 60 seconds at 200 km/h, then enjoy a calm parachute ride with breathtaking views. Want to make your tandem skydive even better? Book as a group!
